text:
Maya Patel: quick check — after yesterday's launch we need to decide follow-on work. propose splitting into a 48h hotfix sprint for critical bugs and a 2-week ‘delight’ wave for UX polish/features. thoughts?
Sanjay Rao: +1 on hotfix-first. what do we class as 'critical'?
Maya Patel: good Q. criteria: user-facing crashes, data loss, regressions >5% error rate, or SLA/customer-blocking complaints. initial hit list below.
Maya Patel: ```
Hotfix candidates (initial):
- streaming handler crash (session drop on long responses)
- embedding mismatch: prod/staging vector drift for a subset of tenants
- auth token expiry regression causing 401s on retry
- long-tail p95 latency spike on /v1/generate (>5s)
- billing-export failure for customers on legacy CSV flow
```
Leah Kim: can we score by #users affected + SLA risk + dev effort? that lets us pick top 3 for the 48h box. Leah: I'll take comms for any affected customers (ACME flagged billing).
Sanjay Rao: yep — I'll run a quick impact x effort matrix now and post results. pinging @Tom Becker for infra complexity notes.
Tom Becker: infra note: streaming handler patch is a config fallback we can ship in ~24–48h, but KV cache invalidation for embedding mismatch is riskier and needs a rollout plan. billing-export fix likely needs a data backfill window.
ops-bot: incident logged: INC-2024-2347 — streaming handler crash (link: https://incidents/reports/INC-2024-2347)
Maya Patel: proposed decision: take top 3 into the hotfix sprint — streaming crash, auth 401 regression, billing-export failure (ACME priority). remaining items go to the 2-week delight wave for grooming/estimates.
Leah Kim: noted. I'll draft customer note to ACME and update the status page. ETA for ACME note: today EOD.
Sanjay Rao: estimates (rough): streaming fix 8h dev + 4h QA, auth token 12h dev + 6h QA, billing-export 16h dev + 8h QA + small backfill window. I'll attach the matrix in this thread once done.
Maya Patel: logistics: owners assigned — Sanjay (streaming + latency), Tom (infra assist + rollout), Leah (customer comms + billing coordination), Maya (product / prioritization). target: hotfix deploy by Tue EOD; grooming + backlog triage Wed AM to schedule delight wave in next sprint.
Tom Becker: I'll reserve a staging window tonight for full e2e tests and a canary slot tomorrow morning.
Leah Kim: also want to add a low-risk quantization experiment to the delight wave to see if it trims p95 for older models — scheduling as a nice-to-have, not blocking hotfix.
Sanjay Rao: added to the backlog board. will post the impact matrix + ticket links in 30m.
Maya Patel: sweet. decision logged here: hotfix-first (top 3), enhancements second wave. Leah please tag any affected customers and update roadmap board.
Leah Kim: will do. tagging cust-ACME and updating the roadmap card with owners + ETA.
Maya Patel: thanks team. I'm going to open a follow-up thread with PR links and short checklist (deploy slots, QA owner, rollback plan). leaving this thread for updates. :thumbsup:
Sanjay Rao: LGTM, will update when matrix is ready.
Tom Becker: noted, will stand by for canary.
Leah Kim: done — ACME note draft posted to #customer-comm and PR opened for billing export fix.
Maya Patel: closing loop for now — owners + timeline above. reopen thread if any blocker pops up.
